title: How authorised and unauthorised numbers are marked is not explained
body_md: In the syntax graphic the source explains only the country code and the smartphone marker. How a destination number is marked as authorised or unauthorised follows solely from an example and is never written out as a rule. This manual derives no rule from the example. The marking is an open, safety-critical item.
source_region: Section 2.8, explanations of the syntax graphic
prev_context: Before this stands the description of the syntax graphic.
next_context: The example table and section 2.9 follow on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 16: the German graphic explains exactly the same two characters and likewise not the marking of authorisation. The gap is therefore independently confirmed and is not a reading error. BLK-006 remains binding.
